comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
New limited time event from 1/22 to 2/5. JP server data on it: gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?LiveEvent/TryYourLuckOnceADay10

Assuming nothing has changed from the listed data, once a day you can make a a 100k or 10m ducat investments to a Well-Dressed Gentleman NPC in Major City taverns/rest houses will yield this lotto item. Confirmed locations:

Amsterdam
London
Lisbon
Seville
Marseille
Venice
Istanbul
Alexandria
Genoa
Naples
Tunis
Athens
Stockholm
Cape
Calicut
Jakarta
Santo Domingo
Portobelo
San Francisco
Sakai
Hangzhou

Potential other ports: Anping/Hanyang/St. Petersburg/Aden/Rio de Janeiro/Lima?

Basically, if it's a city with quest mediators, you'll surely be able to find a Gentleman NPC to invest with. Now, as for this item, you must make a 10m investment. Here is a list of its possible drops:

Emergency Shipbuilding Request x20
Land Redevelopment Handbook x15
Shipwreck Map Piece x15
Essay on Navigation x5
Custom Tailoring Tools x2
Aide Production Order Paper
Mead of Poetry x3
Battle Beast's Pendant x5
Skidbladnir's Steer
Tree of Life
Cat Ears
Copper Holy Grail x2
Spirit's Box x1
Original Ship Permit x1
Lace Frill Dress

Although high-end rewards are often changed for Maris international server, the comments above show that this has apparently not happened. That's good news, right? I've reposted the No.9 drop list here with small updates/fixes as a result. Cheers.

Source: uwo.papayaplay.com/uwo.do?tp=news.view&postid=2832
